item.title: New SNAP work requirements kick in for more states Feb. 1: What to know
item.description: New work requirements are starting in more states Sunday for Americans who receive Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits. Here’s what to know about the changes.New SNAP work requirementsThe massive tax cuts and spending bill signed into law in July by President Donald Trump added more requirements for many adult SNAP recipients to work, volunteer or participate in job training for at least 80 hours a month. item.title: TSA charging $45: How ConfirmID works for those without REAL ID
item.description: The REAL ID deadline is in effect, after years of delay during the pandemic.
